tn_foster_falls.name: Foster Falls
tn_foster_falls.note: Year-round; local guide says fall and spring best, no months named

az_stewart_pocket.name: Stewart Pocket
az_stewart_pocket.note: Fall (October cooler) best, summer scorching, winter creek crossing; no month-naming second source

ma_eastern_ma.name: Eastern, MA
ma_eastern_ma.note: HELD by reviewer: a whole region; one quarry listing does not speak for it. Quincy Quarries guide lists March-November; EMS says climbable year round and extends fall into November; spring/fall best. Sources speak for Quincy/Boston crags

or_broughton_bluff.name: Broughton Bluff
or_broughton_bluff.note: MP: late spring, summer, fall best, winter damp; Next Adventure says fall best, summer hot; no months named

ar_east_side.name: East Side
ar_east_side.note: HELD by reviewer: statewide Arkansas sources only. Statewide sources name mid-Sep to mid-May and Oct-Apr (cool, drier), spring/fall best; not Horseshoe-specific; early Sep still blazing hot per MP forum, summer hot

ny_peterskill.name: Peterskill
ny_peterskill.note: Reviewer: Gunks system window (rounds 3-4). Gunks guides: Sep-Oct prime, spring (mid-Mar/Apr-May) popular but wetter, summer hot/humid; Peterskill closed to climbing in winter

tn_king_s_bluff.name: King's Bluff
tn_king_s_bluff.note: South-facing, sunny year-round, shaded in summer; no best-months named

id_east_idaho.name: East Idaho
id_east_idaho.note: Heise basalt: late spring through fall per MP text only; no months and no second source

md_northwest_branch.name: Northwest Branch
md_northwest_branch.note: Only Carderock-next-door guidance: spring-fall, spring/fall better than humid summer; no months named

nv_willow_spring.name: Willow Spring
nv_willow_spring.note: Red Rocks: Oct to early Apr best, July unbearable; Kaya prime Nov-Mar with Sep/Oct and Apr/May shoulders; Willow Spring has some shaded problems

on_rattlesnake_point.name: Rattlesnake Point
on_rattlesnake_point.note: Spring Fling event on June 1 described as season kickoff; no season months found

ca_texas_canyon.name: Texas Canyon
ca_texas_canyon.note: Only one site lists Jan-Mar; bees in spring; no second source

sd_palisades_state_park.name: Palisades State Park
sd_palisades_state_park.note: Spring through fall / late spring to fall, buggy humid summer; season words only

mn_he_mni_can_barn_bluff_red_wing.name: He Mni Can - Barn Bluff (Red Wing)
mn_he_mni_can_barn_bluff_red_wing.note: No source names a climbing season

wv_bubba_city.name: Bubba City
wv_bubba_city.note: NPS: year-round but best late April to mid-June and mid-September to late October; AAC agrees spring and fall. Sources speak for whole New River Gorge

ar_cowell.name: Cowell
ar_cowell.note: HELD by reviewer: statewide Arkansas sources only. Statewide Arkansas sources name mid-Sep to mid-May and Oct-Apr (cool, drier), spring/fall best; not Cowell-specific

ca_riverside_quarry.name: Riverside Quarry
ca_riverside_quarry.note: Spring and fall prime, south-facing sectors good in winter; no months named

co_colorado_national_monument.name: Colorado National Monument
co_colorado_national_monument.note: MP: fall through spring, summers too hot; Skyward: spring and fall; season words only; NPS raptor closures Mar 1-Jul 31 on some routes

ga_mount_yonah.name: Mount Yonah
ga_mount_yonah.note: Spring and fall best, hot summer, wet winter; no months named
